I'll bisect this.
Reverting PR #111452 or using `#define RESPV_ENABLED 0` fixes the issue. CC @DarioSamo

I opened an issue upstream to re-spirv (https://github.com/renderbag/re-spirv/issues/17) and a PR with a potential fix (https://github.com/renderbag/re-spirv/pull/18).

As discussed in the rendering team meeting, the PR is only meant to be used as a starting point and not necessarily to be merged as-is, but the Issue does seem (to the best of my ability and after doing local verification of the output) to have identified the location of the issue.
